entries.proposition: Design: plasma untargeted metabolomics in 62 epilepsy patients (infrequent n=31, frequent n=31) against 20 healthy controls, DisGeNET enrichment, then PTZ-kindled male mice. The only oxygen-related content is HIF-1 pathway and ferroptosis markers; no oxygen exposure is applied.
entries.snippet: The study consisted of a total of eighty-two subjects: sixty-two epilepsy patients categorized into infrequent seizure (IS) (n = 31) and frequent seizures (FS) (n = 31)

entries.proposition: The paper reports no anti-seizure medication, comorbidity or treatment data for patients, although its inclusion rules exclude severe systemic disease.
entries.snippet: Sixty-two epilepsy patients who met the inclusion and exclusion criteria were divided into the infrequent seizures group (IS, n=31) and the frequent seizures group (FS, n=31).

entries.proposition: Metabolomics: free fatty acids and bilirubin higher, glutamine and arginine lower in patients; HIF-1 pathway appears only in negative-ion KEGG enrichment (adjusted p below 0.05), none in positive mode.
entries.snippet: In the positive ion mode, no significantly enriched pathways were identified among the differential metabolites.

entries.proposition: DisGeNET step: 1215 epilepsy genes yield 73 hub genes from a protein-interaction network; HIF-1 signalling is then reported as enriched among them.
entries.snippet: we identified a core network and 73 hub target genes

entries.proposition: Mouse model: PTZ 35 mg/kg every other day, eleven injections; 83.3 percent kindled; pathway readouts are mRNA and protein for HIF-1 alpha and HO-1 (higher in PTZ).
entries.snippet: These results suggest that HIF-1α/HO-1 pathway is significantly activated in the hippocampus of PTZ kindling epileptic mice.

entries.proposition: Ferroptosis support is a panel of markers in the hippocampus (COX-2, Fe2+, ferritin, transferrin, GPX4, MDA) and small mitochondrial size by electron microscopy.
entries.snippet: the mitochondria of hippocampal neurons in the PTZ group became smaller, the membrane density increased, and the mitochondrial ridge decreased or disappeared
entries.anchor: Results, Validation of hippocampal neurons ferroptosis

entries.proposition: The authors state the central claim is correlational: no intervention on HIF-1 alpha or HO-1 was done.
entries.snippet: the study predominantly establishes correlations between the HIF-1α/HO-1 pathway activation, ferroptosis markers, and epilepsy

entries.proposition: Conclusion drawn beyond the data: the Discussion says the pathway 'might promote' epilepsy and proposes inhibiting HIF-1 alpha and regulating iron as treatments, which no experiment here tests.
entries.snippet: Inhibiting the activation of the HIF-1α/HO-1 pathway and regulating iron metabolism may offer potential approaches for epilepsy treatment.

entries.proposition: Supplementary Table S2 lists the 1215 epilepsy genes taken from DisGeNET; WWOX is one of them (row 252), the only WWOX-direct item in the paper, and it is not among the 73 hub genes.
entries.snippet: Epilepsy	WWOX	51741	WW domain containing oxidoreductase

entries.proposition: Supplementary Table S4: the HIF-1 signalling pathway is the 22nd of the listed enriched pathways, below lipid and atherosclerosis, IL-17, cancer and TNF pathways, with 15 of the 73 hub genes including HIF1A itself.
entries.snippet: hsa04066:HIF-1 signaling pathway	NOS3, STAT3, IGF1, HIF1A, EGFR, MTOR, RELA, INS, VEGFA, IL6, IFNG, AKT1, MAPK1, GAPDH, TLR4	15	73

entries.proposition: Figures 4 to 6: bar charts each carry three dots per group (PTZ versus control) for COX-2, Fe2+, ferritin, transferrin, GPX4, SOD, CAT, GSH-Px, MDA, HIF-1 alpha and HO-1; blots show three control and three PTZ lanes; the ROS panel (Fig 5D) is DHE images for CA1, CA3 and DG without a quantification plot in the figure; Fig 4D electron micrographs with arrows on mitochondria; Fig 4C HE sections.

entries.proposition: Figures 1 to 3 and the graphical abstract: OPLS-DA separation of NC, IS and FS; box plots of palmitic, oleic, linoleic and myristic acids (higher), arginine and glutamine (lower), bilirubin (higher, IS-FS difference n.s.); KEGG bubble plots with the HIF-1 pathway highlighted in negative mode; the DisGeNET hub network with HIF1A, TNF, IL6, GAPDH and others; GO bars; KEGG bubble plot with HIF-1 highlighted in the middle of a list headed by cancer pathways.
